<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). The peaks at 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm each appear twice, giving a total of 12 aromatic carbon signals. Therefore the compound contains 12 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
